difficulty_evidence: Authored workload classification from two unrated sources and canonical point-slope example; not recovered MA ratings.

exceptions.scope: bounded validated package; not a proof of inherent impossibility
exceptions.evidence: Both source questions are unrated and ask only one parallel-line equation from a given slope and point. Canonical example uses the same direct method.
exceptions.reason: No supported hard workload within these two templates. Harder constructions would introduce unverified scope or arbitrarily relabel the same work.
exceptions.reopen_on: new source evidence or separately validated in-scope hard extension

finite_limits: Exact normal task capacities are counted exhaustively in validation.json; source/canonical and already shown/reserved tasks must be subtracted at preparation. Identity, seed, choice order and reference intercept do not increase capacity.
